title: Harden credential and supply-chain boundaries
description: Track remediation from static security review of HEAD 14bcdd9. No intentional malware was found, but credential routing, CI secret exposure, logging, networked tests, mutable automation, dependency reproducibility, and provenance require hardening.
acceptance_criteria: All child remediation issues are closed; final sandboxed verification is complete; no credential-exfiltration path remains in reviewed trust boundaries.

title: Restrict request-level API endpoint overrides
description: Completion and embedding requests accept :api-base in src/litellm/schemas.clj:112-117,189-194. src/litellm/core.clj:98-107,202-205 lets request transport fields override trusted config, while src/litellm/router.clj:90-93 can add a registered API key. Provider clients then send that key to the selected base URL. Attacker-influenced request maps can redirect trusted credentials or target internal services.
acceptance_criteria: Untrusted request data cannot override the destination used with trusted credentials; custom proxy endpoints require explicit trusted configuration and scheme/host validation or documented opt-in; completion, streaming, embedding, and router tests cover redirect attempts.
close_reason: Fixed in 5249df0c. Request endpoints rejected for completion/streaming/embedding/router; explicit config URL validated, config credentials win. Regression 2 tests/14 assertions/12 failures before, full suite 258 tests/1147 assertions/0 failures after. make lint clean; format/check unavailable. Hato dependency inspected: redirects default never. Intentional API break documented in doc/security.md.

title: Remove provider secrets from pull-request E2E runs
description: .github/workflows/e2e.yml:3-6 runs on pull_request, executes checked-out repository code at lines 38-42, and passes seven provider secrets/endpoints at lines 43-50. Same-repository PR code can exfiltrate credentials or spend quota.
acceptance_criteria: Credentialed E2E does not run automatically on pull_request; execution occurs only post-merge or through protected manual approval/environment controls; PR checks remain credential-free; credential scope and rotation procedure are documented.

title: Redact credentials from errors and diagnostics
description: src/litellm/errors.clj:73-85 stores full requests/configs in exception context; validators pass full requests at src/litellm/providers/core.clj:489-508; router copies registered API keys into requests at src/litellm/router.clj:90-93; error-details returns context unchanged at src/litellm/errors.clj:398-412. Documentation and E2E helpers log this data.
acceptance_criteria: Exception construction and error-details recursively redact API keys, Authorization/header values, AWS secrets/session tokens, passwords, and token-like fields; docs/examples/tests no longer recommend or print unsafe full context; tests prove nested secrets never appear in rendered errors or logs.

title: Make default unit tests network-free
description: make test runs the default Kaocha suite, but untagged tests in test/litellm/core_test.clj:173-213,283-302 and test/litellm/router_test.clj:355-388 invoke real provider clients and localhost Ollama with missing or fake keys. The nominal unit suite therefore generates unexpected network traffic.
acceptance_criteria: Default unit and coverage suites pass with outbound network blocked; provider calls are mocked or live cases are tagged integration/e2e; a guard fails tests on any unmocked network request; documentation clearly identifies commands that make billable/live calls.
close_reason: Fixed by offline suite guard and fake-only core/router tests; code commit recorded in next ledger sync

comments.author: vedang
comments.text: Fix commit 19944add. Regression before: 13 tests failed on 14 blocked HTTP attempts. After: make test 256 tests/1133 assertions/0 failures; make coverage passed; make lint 0 errors/0 warnings. make format/check targets absent. Hato request* guard blocks even swallowed exceptions.

title: Pin GitHub Actions and enforce least privilege
description: Workflows use mutable action tags in .github/workflows/e2e.yml:15-29, test.yml:21-35,56, and lint.yml:17-26. Permissions are implicit and checkout credentials remain persisted by default. A moved or compromised action can alter CI behavior before secret-bearing steps.
acceptance_criteria: Every third-party action is pinned to a reviewed full commit SHA with a version comment; workflows declare minimal permissions; checkout sets persist-credentials false unless justified; automated dependency update policy covers action SHAs; CI behavior remains documented.

title: Stop logging prompts and raw SSE payloads
description: Anthropic streaming logs the transformed request at src/litellm/providers/anthropic.clj:411-416, and malformed SSE paths log raw lines at lines 460-470 and equivalent provider parsers. Logs may contain prompts, tool arguments, generated content, or user data.
acceptance_criteria: Default logs never contain request bodies, prompts, tool arguments, generated content, or raw SSE lines; diagnostics retain safe metadata such as provider, model, request ID, status, size, and chunk number; log-capture tests cover parse failures and streaming requests.

title: Make dependencies and CI caches reproducible
description: deps.edn:54-55 uses mutable antq version RELEASE. Direct versions do not lock the transitive graph, and CI cache fallback keys in test.yml:34-42 and e2e.yml:28-36 accept broad stale cache matches. This weakens build reproducibility and artifact provenance.
acceptance_criteria: antq uses an exact reviewed version; dependency provenance or resolved-basis/SBOM strategy is documented and reproducible; cache keys and restore policy avoid accepting unrelated stale dependency state or add integrity validation; dependency audit results are recorded.

title: Standardize repository and release provenance
description: The clone remote is unravel-team/litellm-clj, while build.clj:25-30 and README.md:7-8 point to unravel-team/clj-litellm; generated POM metadata includes unauthenticated git://. Current history is mostly unsigned. Inconsistent source metadata weakens source-to-artifact verification.
acceptance_criteria: All metadata uses one canonical HTTPS repository URL; unauthenticated git:// references are removed; release procedure documents signed tags/commits and artifact checksums or attestations; a consumer can map a published artifact to a reviewed source revision.

title: Run sandboxed post-remediation security verification
description: Static review could not inspect external Maven artifacts, transitive dependencies, GitHub Action implementations, provider behavior, DNS/redirects, AWS credential-chain internals, or runtime logging configuration. Perform controlled dynamic verification only after remediation.
acceptance_criteria: In a disposable credential-free environment, resolve and audit dependencies/actions, generate SBOM or equivalent evidence, run build and offline tests with monitored/blocked egress, confirm no unexpected processes/files/network destinations, and attach commands plus findings; any live-provider test remains separately gated.
